concept: A cinematic, recruiter-focused 3D interactive universe showcasing Lokesh Shakthi's engineering journey as a Software Engineering Analyst at Accenture specializing in .NET, SQL Server, Python, and Data Analytics.
target_audience: Tech Recruiters, Engineering Managers, CTOs, Senior Technical Architects looking for top-tier .NET & Data Engineering talent.
accent_color_strategy: Electric Cyan & Teal glow (#00F5D4, #06B6D4) over deep obsidian (#050811) with glassmorphism overlays.

rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-extrabold text-white
rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

spacing_and_layout.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8
spacing_and_layout.glass_card_style: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 lg:p-8 transition-all duration-300 hover:border-cyan-500/40 hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,245,212,0.1)]

loading_screen.description: Black screen with glowing digital wireframe, system startup text ('INITIALIZING CAREER UNIVERSE...'), loading progress indicator (0-100%), and fast-forward button.

hero_3d.visuals: Central interactive 3D Neural Core / Holographic Wireframe Globe with orbiting data nodes, ambient floating star dust, mouse parallax rotation, and subtle pulse lights.

skill_universe.description: 3D Canvas interactive skill graph. Nodes represent .NET, SQL Server, Python, Data Analytics, React, REST APIs, Microservices, Azure. Hovering highlights connected nodes and displays proficiency meter & real-world Accenture impact.

journey_timeline_3d.description: Interactive vertical 3D timeline with camera scroll markers for milestones: Accenture Software Engineering Analyst role, Data Pipeline optimizations, Enterprise SQL query tuning, Full-stack solution builds.

project_gallery.description: 3D tilt cards with interactive view modal, live code preview snippet, key metric badges (e.g., '40% Query Speedup', '100k+ Records Processed'), technology tags, GitHub & Live Links.

recruiter_quick_drawer.description: A top-right floating button 'Recruiter Mode' that opens a streamlined 1-page executive summary with key stats, top achievements, downloadable PDF resume, and direct schedule/contact options.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Lenis smooth scroll or React Lenis for premium scroll weight.
Use Framer Motion for entrance animations with staggered reveals.
Ensure all interactive buttons, cards, inputs, tabs, and drawer toggles have data-testid attributes.
Include a Recruiter Fast-Track drawer or overlay button to give hiring managers instant access to key bullet points without having to scroll through the full 3D universe.
Add interactive sound toggle effect (subtle sci-fi UI clicks using Web Audio API or soft audio synth, muting by default).
Make sure the mobile view gracefully scales down 3D canvas resolution / particle count to maintain 60 FPS performance.

anti_patterns: No generic white or bright gray backgrounds. Must be dark cinematic obsidian.
No plain default Inter font for headlines. Use Outfit / JetBrains Mono.
No missing contrast for text over transparent overlays.
No raw HTML select or standard input tags; use customized Shadcn/Tailwind controls.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid='...' attributes.
